scripts.buildRust: cargo rustc --features webgpu           --lib --manifest-path ./Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir ../rust -- -C target-feature=+simd128 && pwsh -Command cp ../rust/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/engine.wasm ../wwwroot/engine.wasm
scripts.buildRust-prod: cargo rustc --features webgpu --release --lib --manifest-path ./Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir ../rust -- -C target-feature=+simd128 && pwsh -Command cp ../rust/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/engine.wasm ../wwwroot/engine.wasm
scripts.build: npm run buildRust && tsc -b  && npm run buildWasmSimd
scripts.build-prod: npm run buildRust-prod && tsc -b  && npm run buildWasmSimd
scripts.test: npm run test-unit && npm run test-integration && npm run test-wasm && npm run test-rust
scripts.test-integration: npm run buildRust && start npm run swa && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js  --forceExit --detectOpenHandles --runInBand --silent=false --config=jest.integration.config.js
